DB.description: D1 database used to store encrypted private notes and auth rate-limit records.

APP_PASSWORD.description: Strong password for new default vaults. During a legacy upgrade, keep the existing value through the first post-upgrade login so its encryption key-check can be initialized; retain that old vault passphrase until all notes are re-encrypted.

COOKIE_SECRET.description: Long random secret used to sign the HttpOnly session cookie.

APP_PASSWORDS.description: Optional additional isolated vaults. Format: vault_id=password,guest=another-password.
